item.text:
**1B.3 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador in 2024**

I stopped after 6 search/fetch calls. Direct 2024 evidence on nuclear command-and-control is structurally thin because Mexico is not a nuclear-armed state, so the best available evidence is from civilian nuclear safety, radiological regulation, emergency preparedness, and spent-fuel custody at Laguna Verde.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Entrada en vigor de la NOM-008-NUCL-2024](https://www.gob.mx/cnsns/articulos/entrada-en-vigor-de-la-nom-008-nucl-2024?idiom=es) | Comisión Nacional de Seguridad Nuclear y Salvaguardias / Gobierno de México | 2024-06-20 | https://www.gob.mx/cnsns/articulos/entrada-en-vigor-de-la-nom-008-nucl-2024?idiom=es | Mexico updated radiological contamination limits and criteria for control, explicitly to minimize exposure and tighten controls at radiological and nuclear installations. This is direct evidence of strengthened safety regulation and accident-prevention safeguards in 2024. | 1B.3 |
| [En Veracruz, Gobierno de México concluye exitosamente simulacro en Central Nucleoeléctrica de Laguna Verde](https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/en-veracruz-gobierno-de-mexico-concluye-exitosamente-simulacro-en-central-nucleoelectrica-de-laguna-verde) | Secretaría de Seguridad y Protección Ciudadana / Gobierno de México | 2024-05-23 | https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/en-veracruz-gobierno-de-mexico-concluye-exitosamente-simulacro-en-central-nucleoelectrica-de-laguna-verde | The federal government and CFE ran a Laguna Verde emergency drill that tested notification, evacuation, radiological protection, medical care, and public assistance under the external radiological emergency plan. This is strong evidence of accident-preparedness and command discipline. | 1B.3 |
| [Aviso de adjudicación de contrato: Almacenamiento de combustible nuclear gastado en ISFSI de la Central Nucleoeléctrica Laguna Verde](https://sidof.segob.gob.mx/notas/docFuente/5744879) | Diario Oficial de la Federación / CFE | 2024-12-10 | https://sidof.segob.gob.mx/notas/docFuente/5744879 | CFE awarded a contract for spent nuclear fuel storage at Laguna Verde’s ISFSI. That is direct custody/safeguards evidence: the government was managing spent fuel storage rather than leaving it ad hoc. | 1B.3 |
| [NEWS: Declaration of Unusual Event (NUP-4.1)](https://www-news.iaea.org/ErfView.aspx?mId=cfd216c1-7b9d-4653-9e55-10b13e8da30d) | International Atomic Energy Agency | 2024-01-12 | https://www-news.iaea.org/ErfView.aspx?mId=cfd216c1-7b9d-4653-9e55-10b13e8da30d | On 4 January 2024, Laguna Verde Unit 1 had smoke and fire in an MCC cubicle, leading the IAEA to log a “Declaration of Unusual Event.” Even with final INES 0, this is negative evidence that accident-prevention safeguards were not perfect. | 1B.3 |
| [Se agudizan las fallas en Laguna Verde durante este sexenio](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/periodismo-de-investigacion/se-agudizan-las-fallas-en-laguna-verde-durante-este-sexenio/) | El Universal | 2024-08-18 | https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/periodismo-de-investigacion/se-agudizan-las-fallas-en-laguna-verde-durante-este-sexenio/ | This investigation says the January fire at Laguna Verde lasted hours and that the fire alarm did not work adequately, citing an internal condition report. If accurate, it is stronger negative evidence that safety systems and rapid-response controls were under strain. | 1B.3 |

**Synthesis**

- Best-supported positive reading: AMLO’s 2024 administration did strengthen or at least actively maintain safety, custody, and accident-prevention mechanisms around civilian nuclear material, especially at Laguna Verde.
- Strongest positive evidence is the new radiological contamination standard, the formal emergency drill, and the spent-fuel storage contract.
- Strongest negative evidence is the January 2024 Laguna Verde fire/unusual event and reporting that the alarm response was inadequate.
- Net judgment from this record: **mixed, but leaning positive on institutional safeguards**. The evidence supports active safety management, while also showing a real operational incident that cuts against a clean “strongly strengthened” claim.

**Search gap**

- I did not find a Mexico-specific 2024 public record about nuclear-weapon command-and-control, because Mexico has no nuclear arsenal.
- So the evidence is necessarily indirect and centered on civilian nuclear safety, radiological regulation, emergency planning, and spent-fuel custody.
